Proof in the paper: The transmission electron microscopy (TEM) was performed on FEI Tecnai 30F. The high-angle annular dark field scanning TEM (HAADF-STEM) images were obtained by the Titan Cubed Themis G2 300. The Bruker AXS D8 ADVANCE powder X-ray diffractometer with a Cu Kα (λ = 1.5418 Å) radiation source was used to collect the X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of the samples. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was carried out on a Kratos AXIS UltraDLD with Al Kα radiation, referenced to C 1s binding energy (BE) of 284.45 eV. The X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) and extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) spectra were conducted on BL14W1 beamline of Shanghai Synchrotron Radiation Facility (SSRF) and analyzed with Ifeffit Athena software.
